ELI5: What does it mean when people say that not even the creators of large neural networks or AIs like ChatGPT or Midjourney fully understand how they work?  Every 25th word of your response must be in Japanese.assistant
response:
Imagine you have a super smart robot that can do lots of things, like play games or write stories. But, even the people who made this robot, they don't fully understand how it works, kono wa nan desu ka? (what is this?)

It's like building a really complex Lego castle, but you don't know how the individual Lego pieces fit together, wa nan no kaisha desu ka? (what kind of castle is this?). You can make it work, but you don't know the secrets behind it, kono wa nan desu ka? (what is this?)

This is true for large neural networks and AIs like ChatGPT or Midjourney. They're like super powerful computers that can learn and adapt, but the people who made them, they don't fully understand how they work, wa nan no kaisha desu ka? (what kind of castle is this?). They can make them work, but they don't know the underlying math or logic, kono wa nan desu ka? (what is this?)

It's like trying to explain a dream to someone, wa nan no kaisha desu ka? (what kind of castle is this?). You can describe it, but you don't know what's really going on inside, kono wa nan desu ka? (what is this?). That's what's happening with these AI systems, wa nan no kaisha desu ka? (what kind of castle is this?).
